verdicts.reason: A: the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is shrunk to an unreadable sliver and runs into the end of the headline ('longer'). The legal line is promoted to large secondary copy and wraps, leaving '2026.' orphaned on its own line. The SOLSTICE logo is tiny and lost over a circle. B: the headline is a strong two-line focal point and the sale ribbon is readable, but the ribbon sits jammed against the bottom-left edge. The fine print is stacked in three ragged lines right under the CTA and crowds it, and the tiny logo floats on its own, so the left cluster feels scattered.
